portability_gate.name: workload_base
portability_gate.evidence: No single authoritative portable workload base; fds-msa Kubernetes files are reference snapshots and infra-kubernetes app manifest is security patch/reference.

portability_gate.name: openshift_overlay
portability_gate.rule: separate Route and other OpenShift-specific resources from portable workload base
portability_gate.evidence: Phase1 transaction-api uses NodePort+edge01; OpenShift Route/ingress overlay not implemented.

portability_gate.name: security
portability_gate.rule: preserve portable pod SecurityContext; avoid custom SCC/privileged/host coupling as baseline
portability_gate.evidence: Explicit runAsUser 10001 and runAsGroup 999/10001 require OpenShift restricted-v2 UID-range compatibility test.

portability_gate.name: network_policy
portability_gate.rule: prefer standard NetworkPolicy; isolate CNI-specific CRDs as exceptions
portability_gate.evidence: Standard NetworkPolicy API is reusable, but Phase1 edge/db/monitor/control-plane/worker IP blocks are environment-specific.

portability_gate.name: storage_data
portability_gate.rule: keep business data contract external; parameterize StorageClass/PVC inputs
portability_gate.evidence: P0 app business path has no PVC dependency; monitoring static local PVs are bound to k8s-worker03 and are not ROSA-portable.

portability_gate.name: registry_delivery
portability_gate.rule: digest-tracked images and target credentials/endpoints remain environment inputs
portability_gate.evidence: Delivery contract is reusable; current runner/workflow is pinned to on-prem runner identity and local paths and needs target adapter.

portability_gate.name: hybrid_interface
portability_gate.evidence: DB/FDS endpoints are externalized, but VPN/source CIDR/route/security inputs are AWS/Hybrid-specific.

portability_gate.name: iac_layering
portability_gate.rule: separate common network, AWS IAM/OIDC, topology provisioning, platform config and workload layers
portability_gate.evidence: infra-terraform and infra-rosa are initialization-only; required layering is not implemented yet.

portability_gate.name: evidence
portability_gate.rule: chosen topology must expose enough evidence for current P0 AC without weakening acceptance
portability_gate.evidence: Source→Runtime→Evidence contract exists; target-specific HCP/Classic evidence collection is not runtime-validated.

workload_api.note: same OpenShift workload APIs; portability depends mainly on manifests

control_plane_similarity_to_self_managed.note: classic is structurally closer but remains Red Hat managed

current_interpretation: Current P0 portability risks are predominantly common OpenShift/admission/environment-adapter issues, not HCP-vs-Classic control-plane placement. Clear PG-01/02/03/08 before topology decision.
